---
title: "Launcher"
sidebar: api
---

`launcher` tapers a large pad to a CPW neck. It also defines a simulation-boundary
marker at the pad side.

## Build the default component

```python
import gdsfactory as gf
from orcapen_sc_pdk import activate

activate()
component = gf.get_component("launcher")
```

## Parameters

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pad_width`, `pad_length` | 150 µm, 150 µm | Pad dimensions. |
| `taper_length` | 150 µm | Transition length from pad to CPW neck. |
| `side_gap_height`, `end_gap_width` | 85 µm, 85 µm | Ground-mask clearances at pad sides and end. |
| `cpw_xs` | `coplanar_waveguide` | CPW neck cross-section. |

## Ports and layers

`o_neck` and `o_pad` are DRAW route ports. `o_lumped` marks the simulation
boundary; it is not a solver result. The factory creates DRAW, ETCH,
GROUND_MASK, and SIM_BOUNDARY geometry.
